about: 자가사용입력 클릭 대조(2026-10-30) — 머리 [새로운 항목 추가](전표 비고) · 줄 [새로운 항목 추가](줄 적요)에 글을 넣어 저장하면 서버에 남고 수정 창에 다시 든다. 저장 뒤 격자 · 거래처 · 머리 비고는 비고 창고는 남는다. [정렬] '정렬기준' · [주문] '주문서검색창(조회)' · [전표불러오기] '메뉴검색' 창, [저장(F8)▴] 저장/전자결재 · 저장/내용유지 · 저장/신규. 만든 전표는 끝에 지운다.

shots.name: 자가사용입력 — 머리 · 줄 [새로운 항목 추가] 를 넣어 저장, 서버에 남고 화면은 창고만 남긴다
steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? JSON.stringify(b) : undefined }).then(async (r) => ({ status: r.status, body: await r.json().catch(() => null) })); true

js:(async()=>{const st=(await window.__api('GET','/stock')).body;const whs=(await window.__api('GET','/warehouses')).body;const uniq=(id)=>{const c=whs.find((w)=>w.id===id).code;return whs.filter((w)=>w.code.toLowerCase().includes(c.toLowerCase())).length===1};const a=st.find((s)=>Number(s.quantity)>=5&&uniq(s.warehouseId));sessionStorage.setItem('sun',JSON.stringify({wh:a.warehouseId,whCode:whs.find((w)=>w.id===a.warehouseId).code,a:a.itemId,ac:a.itemCode,mark:'QAN'+Date.now()%100000}));return true})()

js:(async()=>{const s=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sun'));const sl=(ms)=>new Promise((r)=>setTimeout(r,ms));const setv=(i,v)=>{Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(i,v);i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}))};const ent=(i)=>i.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true}));const wh=document.querySelector('input[placeholder="창고"]');wh.focus();setv(wh,s.whCode);await sl(200);ent(wh);await sl(400);const it=document.querySelectorAll('input[aria-label="품목검색"]')[0];it.focus();setv(it,s.ac);await sl(150);ent(it);await sl(300);setv(document.querySelector('input[aria-label="1줄 수량"]'),'1');setv(document.querySelector('input[aria-label="새로운 항목 추가"]'),'머리 '+s.mark);setv(document.querySelector('input[aria-label="1줄 새로운 항목 추가"]'),'줄 '+s.mark);await sl(200);return true})()

js:(async()=>{const s=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('sun'));const r=(await window.__api('GET','/stock-adjustments?type=SELF_USE&all=true')).body;const row=r.rows.find((x)=>x.reason==='줄 '+s.mark);if(!row){window.__ok=false;return false}const slip=(await window.__api('GET','/stock-adjustments/slips/'+encodeURIComponent(row.adjustNo))).body;window.__ok=slip.headerNote==='머리 '+s.mark;await window.__api('DELETE','/stock-adjustments/slips/'+encodeURIComponent(row.adjustNo));return window.__ok})()
